import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    private static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    private static final int MAX_N = 2000;
    private static int[][] dp = new int[MAX_N + 5][2 * MAX_N + 5];
    private static int[][] ok = new int[MAX_N + 5][MAX_N + 5];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        ok[0][0] = 1;
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= MAX_N; i++) {
            for (int j = i & 1; j <= i; j += 2) {
                if (j == 0) {
                    dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j + 1];
                    if (ok[i - 1][j + 1] == 1) {
                        dp[i][j] = (dp[i][j] + 1) % MOD;
                    } else {
                        ok[i][j] = 1;
                    }
                } else {
                    dp[i][j] = (dp[i - 1][j - 1] + dp[i - 1][j + 1]) % MOD;
                    if (ok[i - 1][j + 1] == 1 || ok[i - 1][j - 1] == 1) {
                        dp[i][j] = (dp[i][j] + 1) % MOD;
                    } else {
                        ok[i][j] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        System.out.print(dp[2 * n][0]);
    }
}
